wire-format.why: handleSubmit still calls model.save({displayName, website}) on the untouched Backbone model, so toJSON and parse are used for the JSON:API envelope.

validation.why: Validation stays in app.Profile (unmodified) and save() runs it before any network call, with the 'invalid' event shown in the .error span.

no-rollback.why: It uses plain model.save without wait:true, so Backbone's non-wait semantics are unchanged and there is no rollback logic.

header-sync.why: A 'change:displayName' listener updates the element matching headerSelector (default '#header .name') with model.get('displayName').

saved-flash.why: The 'sync' handler sets saved=true and hides it after 1500ms, and the message flags that the fadeOut is now an abrupt hide.

cleanup.why: The useEffect cleanup calls model.off for invalid, sync and change:displayName and clears the timer.
